mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with subsequent wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or INDPRO MoM < -1% does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5%, and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and low GDPC1 growth does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) remains below 5%, it signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the combination of strong PAYEMS and low UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: Real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) increasing by more than 2% YoY signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or RSAFS YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in a month signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or FEDFUNDS MoM < -0.5% does not correlate with subsequent easing actions by the Fed.
